newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat says Pakistan thwarted attempt on his life.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Pakistan thwarted attempt on his life.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said Pakistani authorities had detained suspects who were plotting to kill him during a visit to Islamabad last month, the official Palestinian News Agency WAFA said on Wednesday.

"His excellency has said the Pakistani security apparatus has detained some persons during the emergency meeting of the Islamic Conference Organisation and that according to investigations there was an attempt on me," WAFA quoted Arafat as saying in Gaza on Tuesday.
The dispatch gave no details and no Palestinian officials were immediately available to comment on the report.
Arafat has survived many plots against him since he became head of the Palestine Liberation Organisation nearly 30 years ago.
